_comment: Research-paper-mode parameters for the web tool's interactive analysis path.
_note: These parameters are NOT used by the PAN-PC-11 benchmark pipeline. The benchmark uses reports/implementation/alignment-fusion/frozen-parameters.json.
calibration: tuned on 7 pairs (P1, C1, C2, C3, C4-light, N1 skipped, N2 skipped); not a validated accuracy claim

thresholdSweepTable.description: Sweep of lexical/semantic/hybrid thresholds on the Phase-0 evaluation set. For each threshold, we report C1 recall (should be 1.0), C2 recall (target >= 0.9), and non-boilerplate alerts on P1. N1 and N2 were not available; sweep was based on control pairs only.

lexical.note: CHOSEN: matches Phase-4 informative count; C1 recall maintained
PAN frozen threshold — same result as 0.5 for these pairs
no change on these small pairs

semantic.note: lower threshold increases alerts heavily — not chosen
CHOSEN: matches Phase-4 baseline; PAN frozen value is 0.7 but research papers benefit from lower threshold for paraphrase

hybrid.note: more alerts but no negative pair data to validate
CHOSEN: same informative count as 0.4; lowest threshold that keeps C1 recall = 1.0
PAN frozen threshold — same result for these pairs

choiceRationale.lexical_threshold: 0.5: lowest threshold where C1 informative alert count is unchanged from 0.6; N1/N2 not available to verify false-positive rate; conservative lower bound
choiceRationale.semantic_threshold: 0.6: PAN calibration uses 0.7 for book text; research papers have denser technical vocabulary — 0.6 adds no extra noise on these pairs but would catch lighter paraphrase
choiceRationale.hybrid_alpha: 0.25: retained from PAN calibration; validation selected lexical weight 1.0 on PAN but 0.25 retains semantic contribution for research-paper mode
choiceRationale.hybrid_threshold: 0.5: same reasoning as lexical; no negative-pair data available to validate
